newsitem.title: GERMANY: Italy's Air Dolomiti sees 24pct passenger growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Air Dolomiti sees 24pct passenger growth in 1997.

text.p: Italian regional carrier Air Dolomiti said it expected passenger numbers to rise 24 percent to 350,000 in 1997.
The private airline flew 283,664 passengers in 1996, a 13 percent growth, and recorded a sales turnover increase of 29 percent to 80 billion lire, a statement issued here said.
The six-year-old Triest-based carrier, which has flown profitably since 1995, added that its seat load factor rose to 53.7 percent from 50 percent last year.
International business grew strongly in 1996 with a 28 percent rise to 203,248 passengers, the airline said.
Air Dolomiti flies from six northern Italian cities to Munich, feeding the Deutsche Lufthansa AG intercontinental hub, and to Barcelona and Basle.
But it said domestic Italian traffic, comprising less than 10 percent of business, declined but gave no further details.
Air Dolomiti operates a fleet of seven 46-seat ATR-42 turboprop aircraft.
